asciinema-player 3.17.0 (Apache-2.0), from https://github.com/asciinema/asciinema-player —
the bundle files, unmodified, served next to the page so the landing needs no third-party
script host. `detect-demo.cast` in the parent directory is a recording of
`PAUSE=2 e2e/detect-demo/run.sh` from https://github.com/cpoder/vejas.
